import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
base='0ff81958a611d2c0be54d2ca839b955ae7cb2772'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='trnm-fifo-control-') as td:
 d=pathlib.Path(td);fifo=d/'input.fifo';os.mkfifo(fifo)
 old=d/'baseline_dynamic.py'
 old.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/dynamic_participation_v1.py']))
 records=[]
 for label,path in [('baseline',old),('candidate',root/'formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/dynamic_participation_v1.py')]:
  start=time.monotonic_ns()
  try:
   p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',str(path),'--check',str(fifo)],capture_output=True,timeout=1)
   rec={'label':label,'timed_out':False,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'stderr':p.stderr.decode()}
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
   rec={'label':label,'timed_out':True,'exit_code':None,'stdout':(e.stdout or b'').decode(),'stderr':(e.stderr or b'').decode()}
  rec['elapsed_ns']=time.monotonic_ns()-start;records.append(rec)
 print(json.dumps({'baseline_commit':base,'candidate_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'observations':records,'native_consensus_qualified':False},sort_keys=True))
 assert records[0]['timed_out']
 assert records[1]['exit_code']==2 and not records[1]['timed_out']
 report=json.loads(records[1]['stdout'])
 assert report['check']=='REFUSED' and report['qualification']=='HOLD_NO_GO'
 assert report['native_six_successor_risk_bound'] is None
